en: About 1 million American chips are estimated to have been snuck into China in defiance of American

en: restrictions. These CCTV pictures show one such example. They suggest people associated with the US company

en: Super Micro placed fake equipment in boxes to fool inspectors.
zh: 與美國音樂公司 Super Micro 有關的人在箱子裡放置假設備來欺騙檢查人員。

en: Then they send the real chips to China in unmarked boxes.
zh: 來欺騙檢查人員。然後他們把真正的晶片裝在沒有標記的盒子裡運往中國。

en: Super Micro denies any involvement in the smuggling scheme.
zh: 在沒有標記的盒子裡運往中國。 Super Micro否認參與走私計劃。

en: Smuggling is not happening at a large enough scale to meet China's demands to get ahead in AI.
zh: 走私計劃。走私規模也不足以滿足中國在人工智慧領域取得領先地位的需求。

en: It only provides an estimated 22% of China's AI data center capacity.
zh: 在人工智慧領域取得領先地位的需求。它僅佔中國AI資料中心容量的約22%。

en: Instead, a more reliable workaround has been to rent American chips in other countries' data centers.
zh: 中國AI資料中心容量的約22%。相反，更可靠的解決方法是在其他國家的資料中心租用美國晶片。

en: This is called remote access. In many cases, it's legal and it makes up as much as a quarter of
zh: 國家的資料中心租用美國晶片。這叫做遠端存取。在很多情況下，這是合法的，

en: China's overall AI compute capacity.
zh: 而且它佔中國整體人工智慧運算能力的四分之一之多。

en: Much of this flows through Southeast Asia, especially Malaysia and Singapore.
zh: 其中許多音樂都流經東南亞，尤其是馬來西亞和新加坡。

en: Malaysia's data center capacity has grown so fast that by some estimates, it now has the equivalent of around half of
zh: 新加坡。馬來西亞的資料中心容量成長如此之快，根據一些估計，它現在擁有的運算能力相當於

en: all of the EU's compute capacity by itself.
zh: 現在擁有的運算能力相當於歐盟總運算能力的一半左右。

en: Clearly, this is not all for its own needs.
zh: 。顯然，這並非完全出於自身需求。

en: You think America would be concerned about this.
zh: 需求。你認為美國會對此感到擔憂嗎？

en: Jensen Huang's position was that allowing China access to American chips would keep it dependent on American tech.
zh: 黃仁勳的觀點是，允許中國獲得美國晶片將使中國繼續依賴美國技術。

en: Some in the Trump administration believed this line.
zh: 技術。川普政府中有些人相信這種說法。

en: But that's getting a lot harder to defend now.
zh: 相信這種說法。但現在這種音樂越來越難辯護了。

en: through remote access.
zh: 使用美國人工智慧晶片，包括透過遠端存取的方式。

en: very capable of hiding behind shell companies. And anyway, China's chipmaking industry has
zh: 非常擅長利用空殼公司來隱藏自身利益。而且，

en: progressed rapidly on its own.
zh: 中國的晶片製造產業本身就發展迅速。

en: The country now makes much more of its own chipmaking equipment than it did five years ago.
zh: 本身就發展迅速。該國現在生產的晶片製造設備比五年前多得多。

en: Its leading AI lab, Deep Seek, reportedly plans to pre-train its next model on Huawei's homegrown chips.
zh: 五年前多得多。據報道，華為領先的人工智慧實驗室 Deep Seek 計劃使用華為自主研發的晶片對其下一代模型進行音樂預訓練

en: That would be the clearest sign yet that China's AI capabilities are extending into hardware, not just software.
zh: 。這將是迄今為止最明確的跡象，表明中國的人工智慧能力正在擴展到硬體領域，而不僅僅是軟體領域。

en: With Nvidia under the microscope, China's ability to get American chips may be affected.
zh: 不僅僅是軟體領域。由於英偉達正受到密切關注，中國取得美國晶片的能力可能會受到影響。

en: But with many other routes of securing compute and a rapidly growing domestic industry, China has many ways of keeping
